build_dinotxt_model: build a DinoTxt vision-language model with DINOv2 vision backbone and text transformer encoder
create_dinotxt_config: create a DinoTxtConfig with embed_dim 2048 and frozen vision backbone for image-text alignment
load_dinotxt_checkpoints: load pretrained vision head and text encoder checkpoints from the DINOv2 model hub URL
get_tokenizer: get a BPE tokenizer by downloading the vocab file from the DINOv2 thirdparty URL
review_dinotxt_model: review the DinoTxt model architecture combining DINOv2Wrapper vision backbone with TextTransformer text backbone
